title: Onboard Hestia-13B v1.0: perf profiles, metadata, and changelog automation
author: Maya Patel
description: Add Hestia-13B v1.0 to the model registry with performance profiles, metadata, and automated changelog generation. Motivation: Hestia is a high-quality 13B open model that performs well on our latency/cost target for interactive workloads. This PR adds the model manifest, optimized perf profiles (CPU/GPU/quantized variants), integration tests, and a changelog entry generator that will be picked up by the release automation. Checklist: - [x] Model manifest + metadata (license, tokenizer, architecture) - [x] Performance profiles for p4d, a100, and cpu-quantized targets - [x] Evaluation snapshots and representative prompts - [x] Changelog automation hook for registry releases - [x] Integration tests for model loading and perf baseline - [x] Documentation snippet in registry README Testing: local perf runs on a100 and p4d (latency and memory), CI integration tests (registry smoke tests) and a small canary rollout to internal staging. Rollout plan: merge to main, automated perf validation job will run, then schedule onboarding to production after manual signoff from ML infra.

perf_profiles_summary: Provided profiles tuned for interactive serving: a100 (fp16) targets 80ms median 512 tokens; p4d (bf16) targets 60ms median; cpu-qat (int8) targets 200ms median with reduced memory footprint. Profiles include batch/sequence length buckets, preferred kernels, and recommended quantization flags.
metadata_changes: manifest.yaml includes model_name, version, license (Apache-2.0), tokenizer: sentencepiece, architecture: transformer-decoder, context_window: 4096, params_estimate: 13B, recommended_endpoints and tags.
changelog_automation_details: Added generate_registry_changelog.py which reads model manifests and perf profile diffs to assemble release notes. The script is idempotent and writes to changelogs/registry/YYYY-MM-DD-hestia-13b-v1.0.md. CI job 'registry-changelog' runs on main when model manifests change and fails if changelog entry is missing.
